name: iqlowry
caption:
AGE 27 🎮🏀 Kyle Lowry wasn't an All-Star yet at 27. Immanuel Quickley is 27 right now.

• Lowry at 27 (2013-14): 17.9 PPG, 7.4 APG, 38.0% from three
• Quickley at 27, first 8 games: 17.4 PPG, 5.8 APG
• Lowry's first All-Star game came at 28, then 6 straight
• Half a point apart at the same age

Lowry at 27 or Quickley at 27? 👇

beats.head: LOWRY VS QUICKLEY
beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: Kyle Lowry wasn't an All-Star yet at twenty-seven. Immanuel Quickley is twenty-seven right now.

beats.head: LOWRY AT 27
beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: Lowry at twenty-seven: seventeen point nine points and seven point four assists a night.

beats.head: QUICKLEY AT 27
beats.name: IQ
beats.vo: Immanuel Quickley at twenty-seven, through eight games: seventeen point four points and five point eight assists.

beats.head: WHAT CAME NEXT
beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: Half a point apart. Then at twenty-eight, Lowry made his first All-Star game, and kept going six years straight.

beats.head: WHO'S BETTER?
beats.vo: Lowry at twenty-seven, or Immanuel Quickley at twenty-seven? Comment below.

facts.claim: Lowry (born March 25, 1986) was 27 in the 2013-14 season; his first All-Star selection came in 2014-15 (age 28), and 2019-20 was his sixth straight (6) All-Star selection
